method.sources: Eleven earlier bylined works set review points on untouched and ordinary same-work phrase substitutions. A fresh dated archive, author exclusion, historical text inventories, and exact 12-token exclusion fix held works.
method.fixture: Change exactly one internal eight-word phrase in the central sentence of five source sentences. Match each untouched excerpt with a same-work phrase substitution and two attempts from pinned Apache-2.0 generators. Keep all other source characters exact. Accept one response per generator only with original sentence boundaries.
method.current: First six complete native three-sentence context windows at raw response at least 0.50.
method.one_context: Use the smaller of the mean token margins over the central four words and all eight in the native context.
method.stable: Use the smaller of that persistence value in two contexts: previous+focus and focus+next.
method.local_contrast: Subtract the larger mean of the four preceding or following words from each paired-context persistence value. Keep the smaller contrast.
method.selection: One uniquely strongest eligible candidate per experimental arm. Points equal the second-largest earlier human source group maximum and must be strictly exceeded.
method.qualification: Useful means at least 0.30 nonwhitespace character IoU and 0.50 recall. Report best possible overlap for every arm independently of scores, and false source groups including same-work substitutions.
method.advance: At least two additional held work groups across both generators with at most one extra human group when combined with the current arm. At least six admitted edits per generator.
